typedef long double ld;

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);

        cout << X << '/' << Y;
        return 0;
    }
    ld d = (ld)X / Y;
    ld best_err = 1e7;
    LL best_num = 1, best_den = 1;
    const ld eps = 1e-25;

            best_num = a1;
            best_den = i;

        ld diff2 = fabsl(d - (ld)a2 / i);
        if (diff2 < best_err - eps) {
            best_err = diff2;
            best_num = a2;
            best_den = i;
        }
    }
    cout << best_num << '/' << best_den;
    return 0;
}
